preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(x) <= 10**5 for line in stdin.splitlines() for x in line.split() if x.isdigit())
preconditions.description: All integers in input are within bounds 1 ≤ n, m ≤ 10^5 and 1 ≤ ui, vi, ai, bi ≤ n.
Input consists of exactly n + m lines: first line with n and m, followed by n-1 edges, then m operations.

preconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == 2 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:1+n-1]) and all(len(line.split()) == 2 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1+n-1:])
preconditions.description: Each edge and operation line contains exactly two integers.

preconditions.expression: all(int(ui) != int(vi) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:1+n-1] for ui, vi in [line.split()])
preconditions.description: Each edge connects distinct nodes (ui ≠ vi).

preconditions.expression: all(int(ai) != int(bi) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1+n-1:] for ai, bi in [line.split()])
preconditions.description: Each operation involves distinct nodes (ai ≠ bi).
The given edges form an undirected tree with root at node 1 (connected, acyclic, and root is node 1).

postconditions.expression: len(stdout.split()) == n and all(stdout.split()[i].isdigit() for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: Output contains exactly n space-separated integers, one for each node.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(c) <= n-1 for c in stdout.split())
postconditions.description: Each ci is a non-negative integer ≤ n-1 (since j ≠ i).

postconditions.expression: all(ci == sum(1 for j in range(1, n+1) if j != i and has_common_element(get_node_list(i), get_node_list(j))) for i, ci in enumerate(map(int, stdout.split()), 1))
postconditions.description: For each node i, ci equals the count of nodes j ≠ i such that the lists of node i and node j share at least one common number. Here, get_node_list(i) returns the list of numbers in node i after all operations, and has_common_element(a, b) checks if sets(a) and sets(b) have non-empty intersection.
